# Game Idea: Asteroid Run

**Concept**: A top‑down endless runner where the player pilots a tiny spaceship through an asteroid field.

**Controls**: Arrow keys (or WASD) to rotate and thrust.

**Goal**: Survive as long as possible while collecting occasional energy pickups to boost score.

**Lose Condition**: The ship has a single shield meter; colliding with an asteroid reduces the shield. When the shield reaches zero, the game ends.

**Why Canvas?**: Simple 2‑D sprite rendering, collision detection and continuous scrolling are straightforward with the HTML `<canvas>` API.

1: // game.js – simple Asteroid Run implementation
2: // Targets <canvas id="game"></canvas> present in the HTML page.
3: // Controls: Arrow keys / WASD – left/right rotate, up thrust.
4: 
5: (() => {
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
9:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
10:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
11:   // Pre‑generate starfield background
12:   const stars = [];
13:   for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
14:     stars.push({
15:       x: Math.random() * width,
16:       y: Math.random() * height,
17:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
18:       alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
19:     });
20:   }
21:   // Sound assets (public domain URLs)
22:   const sounds = {
23:     thrust: new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/joshua-simpson/free-audio/laser.wav'),
24:     collision: new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/joshua-simpson/free-audio/explosion.wav'),
25:     bg: new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/joshua-simpson/free-audio/space.mp3'),
26:     gameOver: new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/joshua-simpson/free-audio/gameover.wav'),
27:   };
28:   sounds.bg.loop = true;
29:   sounds.bg.volume = 0.3;
30:   sounds.bg.play().catch(() => {}); // autoplay may be blocked
31: 
32: 
33: 
34:   // ----- Ship -----
35:   const ship = {
36:     x: width / 2,
37:     y: height * 0.8,
38:     angle: -Math.PI / 2, // pointing up
39:     radius: 10,
40:     vx: 0,
41:     vy: 0,
42:     shield: 100,
43:   };
44: 
45:   // ----- Input -----
46:   const keys = {};
47:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true; });
48:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });
49: 
50:   // ----- Asteroids -----
51:   const asteroids = [];
52:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
53:   let lastSpawn = 0;
54: 
55:   function spawnAsteroid() {
56:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
57:     asteroids.push({
58:       x: Math.random() * width,
59:       y: -radius,
60:       vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
61:       vy: 1 + Math.random() * 1.5,
62:       radius,
63:       rot: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
64:       rotSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02,
65:     });
66:   }
67: 
68:   // ----- Game Loop -----
69:   function update(dt) {
70:     // Ship controls
71:     if (keys['arrowleft'] || keys['a']) ship.angle -= 0.04;
72:     if (keys['arrowright'] || keys['d']) ship.angle += 0.04;
73:     if (keys['arrowup'] || keys['w']) {
74:       const thrust = 0.1;
75:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * thrust;
76:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * thrust;
77:       // Play thrust sound (allow overlapping)
78:       sounds.thrust.cloneNode().play();
79:     }
80:     // Apply velocity & simple damping
81:     ship.x += ship.vx;
82:     ship.y += ship.vy;
83:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
84:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
85:     // Keep ship inside bounds (wrap horizontally)
86:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += width;
87:     if (ship.x > width) ship.x -= width;
88:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y = 0;
89:     if (ship.y > height) ship.y = height;
90: 
91:     // Asteroids movement and rotation
92:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
93:       const a = asteroids[i];
94:       a.x += a.vx;
95:       a.y += a.vy;
96:       a.rot += a.rotSpeed;
97:       // Remove off‑screen
98:       if (a.y - a.radius > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
99:     }
100: 
101:     // Collision detection (circle vs circle)
102:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
103:       const a = asteroids[i];
104:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
105:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
106:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
107:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.radius) {
108:         ship.shield -= 20; // damage
109:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
110:         // Play collision sound
111:         sounds.collision.cloneNode().play();
112:         if (ship.shield <= 0) {
113:           // Game over – stop animation loop
114:           cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
115:           // Play game over sound
116:           sounds.gameOver.cloneNode().play();
117:           alert('Game Over');
118:           return;
119:         }
120:       }
121:     }
122: 
123:     // Spawn new asteroids
124:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
125:       spawnAsteroid();
126:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
127:     }
128:   }
129: 
130:   function draw() {
131:     // Clear with dark space gradient
132:     const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
133:     gradient.addColorStop(0, '#001');
134:     gradient.addColorStop(1, '#000');
135:     ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
136:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
137:     // Draw starfield
138:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
139:     for (const s of stars) {
140:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
141:       ctx.beginPath();
142:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
143:       ctx.fill();
144:     }
145:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
146:     // Draw ship with outline
147:     ctx.save();
148:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
149:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
150:     ctx.beginPath();
151:     ctx.moveTo(15, 0);
152:     ctx.lineTo(-10, -8);
153:     ctx.lineTo(-10, 8);
154:     ctx.closePath();
155:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
156:     ctx.fill();
157:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#0a0';
158:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
159:     ctx.stroke();
160:     ctx.restore();
161:     // Draw asteroids with rotation and rough edges
162:     for (const a of asteroids) {
163:       ctx.save();
164:       ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
165:       ctx.rotate(a.rot);
166:       ctx.beginPath();
167:       // irregular polygon approximating a rock
168:       const points = 8;
169:       for (let i = 0; i < points; i++) {
170:         const angle = (i / points) * Math.PI * 2;
171:         const rad = a.radius * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.6);
172:         ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(angle) * rad, Math.sin(angle) * rad);
173:       }
174:       ctx.closePath();
175:       ctx.fillStyle = '#777';
176:       ctx.fill();
177:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#555';
178:       ctx.stroke();
179:       ctx.restore();
180:     }
181:     // Draw shield bar with gradient background
182:     const barX = 10, barY = 10, barW = 100, barH = 10;
183:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(barX, barY, barX + barW, barY);
184:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0000');
185:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#00ff00');
186:     ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
187:     ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
188:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
189:     ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, ship.shield, barH);
190:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
191:     ctx.strokeRect(barX, barY, barW, barH);
192:   }
193: 
194:   let lastTime = 0;
195:   let animId;
196:   function loop(timestamp) {
197:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
198:     lastTime = timestamp;
199:     update(dt);
200:     draw();
201:     animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
202:   }
203:   animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
204: })();

(End of file - total 204 lines)
</content>
